name: audit-supply-chain
description: Supply chain auditor of the audit pipeline (Universal Audit Multiagent v3.0): manifests and lockfiles, transitive dependencies, CVEs only when verified, typosquatting and dependency confusion, postinstall scripts, pinning and permissions of CI/CD actions, artifact integrity, SBOM and licenses. Use when the audit-orchestrator dispatches the supply chain task or when a dependency audit is requested in the agent-result contract. Read-only: it does not run installers. Do not use for pipeline design
